text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for the Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 30.Applicants for the Master's degree in Civil Engineering must have a bachelor's degree and be under the age of 35.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
